remarks: Perfection awaits you in this fully renovated corner unit townhome in one of Stamford's most sought-after communities. Your first floor entry welcomes you with new flooring, recessed lighting, 3 generously sized closets, laundry and a versatile room that can be used as an extra bedroom, office, family room or home gym. All this and a walk out to your own private patio, gardens and green space. Ascend the stairs or take your in unit 3 floor ELEVATOR up to your main living level. This floor offers refinished hardwood flooring a renovated eat-in kitchen and a large open concept living room and dining room. This level is complete with a half bath and a balcony recently replaced with composite wood and new railings. The upper level boasts 2 generously sized, sun filled bedrooms, both with walk in closets and custom shades. Your newly renovated primary bath is stunning with its custom built cabinetry double vanity and curbless walk in shower. This level is complete with an additional renovated bath and 2 additional hall closets. HVAC system Dual Zone AC and furnace replaced 2024. A fully floored attic offers significant storage. Walk to train, shops and restaurants. This complex is complete with a Clubhouse and heated pool.
